description.value: Sushi Garden is an established Japanese sushi chain with three Burnaby locations offering dine-in service in a non-smoking, air-conditioned setting with vegetarian-friendly options. Online ordering is available at all branches. The probable South Burnaby (Highgate) location sits on Kingsway, a major arterial corridor regularly used by cyclists.

The website confirms takeout via online ordering, and the OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes supports a vegetarian option; no bike-specific amenities appear in either source.
